tools.name: repo_health
tools.description: AST-based syntax and hygiene check of all Python files (no imports executed).

inputs.--exclude: list of directory names to skip, default .git venv .venv __pycache__ node_modules

outputs.exit_code: 0 = no syntax errors, 1 = syntax errors found

tools.name: llm_consult
tools.description: Ask Gemini and/or ChatGPT for a second opinion via their REST APIs (stdlib only). OpenAI is paid and requires --allow-paid.

outputs.exit_code: 0 = at least one provider answered, 1 = none answered

tools.name: claude_bridge
tools.description: Loop between a Claude chat (planner/reviewer, no tools) and Claude Code (executor) via the claude CLI until the chat declares FERTIG.

inputs.--cwd: working directory for both sides, default '.'
inputs.--permission-mode: default | acceptEdits | plan (bypassPermissions is not allowed), default 'default'
inputs.--chat-backend: cli (claude -p --tools "") | api (Messages API, needs --allow-paid), default cli
inputs.--transcript: optional path for a JSON transcript

outputs.exit_code: 0 = goal declared done, 1 = stopped without FERTIG
